title: Geometric Abstract Composition
description: A vertical abstract painting featuring bold geometric shapes including orange and black triangles, vertical color blocks in peach, grey, and green, and expressive paint drips. Scattered across the composition are vibrant splashes of pink, yellow, and blue with circular forms and organic brushstrokes against a white background.
prompt: Vertical abstract geometric painting on white canvas with bold orange and black triangular shapes intersecting vertical color blocks in peach, sage green and grey. Dynamic paint drips running down from the forms. Scattered vibrant yellow circles, pink brushstrokes, and small blue and orange accents creating an energetic modern composition with visible texture and drips.
